en: Messages sent while a Codex task is running reach the ongoing turn again when Codex uses subagents. They no longer fail with “expected active turn id … but found …”.
A subagent finishing its own work no longer ends the main Codex task early.
zh: Codex 执行中调用子代理时，执行途中补充的消息可以正常送达当前轮次，不再报错“expected active turn id … but found …”。
子代理完成自己的工作后，不再让主任务提前结束。
